requested_changes.body:
In the context of this file, returning 0 should be safe (everywhere that `lift()` is called)

If we don't make this change, we'll have to relax the types on all the other functions to indicate that `d0` / `d1` could sometimes be `undefined/null` instead of numbers.

comments.body: This type guard is new vs the old version, but I felt it was worthwhile, otherwise `(x: number) => number` signature would have to handle `null/undefined` .  It could be rolled back if we don't want to provide this kind of defensive programming overhead

Technically this exists in a form that involves patching the function with a property, but this code doesn't need that extra property, and that function has a looser type that what I can provide inline here.
